claims.text: Uses ``tiktoken`` (optional dep) for a real BPE count when installed; otherwise a ``chars/4`` heuristic.

claims.text: Degrades cleanly: the reduction *ratio* is meaningful either way, and becomes tokenizer-exact when tiktoken is present.
claims.why: Both paths return integer counts; ratio meaningful. When tiktoken present, uses exact encoding.

claims.text: This is what makes the "92.8% smaller" claim rigorous rather than a hand-wave.

observations.what: Function _encoder is private but used by both public functions; caching with maxsize=1.
count_tokens catches Exception from enc.encode and falls through to heuristic; robust.
tokenizer_name returns 'tiktoken/cl100k_base' even if tiktoken import succeeded but get_encoding fails; _encoder returns None only on exception, so name reflects actual availability.
